title: USS Finch cigar-shaped object shot down near Johnston Island

tellings.quote: guys and they're all talking about the bogey that was seemed to be shot out of the sky

plain: In 1962, near Johnston Island, a small US base in the Pacific, sailors on the USS Finch, a Navy ship, are said to have watched a cigar-shaped object, a "bogey", that seemed to be shot out of the sky. The UFO historian Richard Dolan tells it, passing on what a man named David Noble White Horse told him: that the men were all talking about the object afterwards. If true, it would mean the US military brought down an unknown craft decades ago.
